football_evidence.question: Can Auburn contain Georgia’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.7 points.
supporting: When Auburn has the ball (big plays on the ground): Auburn’s offense turns 12.9% of its runs into explosive gains, and Georgia’s defense gives up explosive gains on 6.2% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Georgia has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Georgia’s offense has allowed a sack on 3.6% of its dropbacks, and Auburn’s defense sacks the quarterback on 8.9% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Auburn has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Auburn’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 12.9% of its runs, and Georgia’s defense stops 15.0% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
In his last two games (Arkansas and Oklahoma), Puglisi averaged 6.9 yards per attempt, against 9.0 in his two games before that.
contradicting: When Georgia has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Georgia’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 10.1% of its runs, and Auburn’s defense stops 16.3% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).

When Auburn has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Auburn’s offense has allowed a sack on 9.9% of its dropbacks, and Georgia’s defense sacks the quarterback on 7.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
When Georgia has the ball (third down): Georgia’s offense converts 57.2% of its third downs, and Auburn’s defense allows opponents to convert 33.0% of their third downs (FBS average 39.5%).

When Georgia has the ball (big plays through the air): Georgia’s offense turns 14.6% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Auburn’s defense gives up explosive gains on 9.7% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.4%).
quarterbacks: Gunner Stockton has completed 94 of 123 passes (76.4%) for 1,296 yards, 10.5 yards per attempt, 15 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in six games for Georgia, and has been sacked on 6 of 129 dropbacks.
Ryan Puglisi has completed 17 of 28 passes (60.7%) for 231 yards, 8.3 yards per attempt, 2 touchdowns and no interceptions in four games for Georgia, and has been sacked on 0 of 28 dropbacks.
Byrum Brown has completed 104 of 158 passes (65.8%) for 1,077 yards, 6.8 yards per attempt, 8 touchdowns and 7 interceptions in five games for Auburn, and has been sacked on 18 of 176 dropbacks.
Gunner Stockton does not appear on Georgia’s initial availability report.
Byrum Brown does not appear on Auburn’s initial availability report.
